reason: The triclinic primitive cell and Z=1 are strongly supported by indexing (20/20 low-angle lines, M(20)=136.9) and the submitted models have plausible density and minimum contacts, but exact structure recovery is not sufficiently established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the trajectory never performed a conventional candidate whole-profile refinement/validation. The P1 coordinates came from a highly flexible 54-coordinate fit to NNLS-extracted, overlap-grouped amplitudes; independent starts produced materially nonmatching frameworks, so the low custom residual does not establish a unique framework or the asserted P1 realization. The three CIFs are not a controlled enumeration of only Co/V order because their coordinates and some site correspondences also change, while Cu Kalpha Co/V contrast is weak and the tested V-site scores were close. Thus the evidence supports the cell, Z, and a plausible average framework much more strongly than the submitted symmetry, exact coordinates, and element ordering, and another scientifically motivated attempt with whole-pattern comparison and explicit competing structures is warranted.
